dogecoin.text:
@marlon_humphrey I would just warn those people not to get into it expecting to become overnight Dogecoin millionaires.  Expect to have great days and terrible days.  

Oh, and always have mutual funds. They aren’t as exciting, but they historically yield a 8-12% ROI.  Dividend stocks are also 👌🏼

@marlon_humphrey Yes.  Crypto is IMO the future of currency.  It’s incredibly volatile, especially meme crypto (i.e Dogecoin, Shiba) 

I think if your young and are looking to invest short term, and have money on the side... feel free to buy it up now while it’s on sale.
